title: UK ministers explore compulsory AI safety reporting
notes: FT page returned HTTP 403 (a help page, no article text); no other outlet found with the same story. Follow-up of The Times report of 9 Oct 2026 (UK AI safety law to stop 'loss of control' over autonomous agents), carried in our 10 Oct edition (item 85). UA.NEWS relays a separate Guardian story (AI minister Kanishka Narayan to say Britain cannot rely only on tech companies to oversee their AI models); not confirmed to be the same story, so not used.
